objects: same physical card in its post-death graveyard incarnation
events: one ordinary trigger per printed Undying instance
replacement-aware battlefield return with one +1/+1 counter
timing: the no-+1/+1-counter intervening condition is checked from the same departure snapshot at trigger creation and resolution
choices: represented destination and counter replacements complete before the return mutates state
apnap: simultaneous Undying and other triggers use the ordinary trigger-placement batch
layers: the source must have died as a creature under the normalized departure event
replacement_effects: zone-destination and counter-quantity replacements resolve inside one precommit tree
copy: granted or copied Undying requires separately trusted typed ability propagation
control_change: the trigger controller stays locked; the card returns under its owner, who places its entry counter under CR 122.6a
zone_change: only the same post-death graveyard incarnation may return
source_leaves: a token or card that leaves the graveyard before resolution cannot return; leaving and returning creates a stale incarnation
